notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There's nothing at this address. Check the link, or go back to the start.

copy.failed: The browser blocked clipboard access. The text is selected: press Ctrl+C (⌘C on a Mac) to copy it.

generic.title: The request failed
generic.why: The server returned an error this version of the app has no description for.
generic.fix: Try again. If it keeps failing, look for the code in the server log.

unreachable.title: Can't reach the server
unreachable.why: The request got no answer: the server may be stopped, or this device may be offline.
unreachable.fix: Check the network and that Live Subtitles is running, then try again.

invalid.title: The server rejected the request
invalid.why: It couldn't read the data that was sent.
invalid.fix: Check the fields and try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page: the app may be older than the server.

failed.title: The request failed
failed.why: Something between this device and the server answered with HTTP {{status}} instead of the server itself.
failed.fix: Try again. If it keeps failing, check the network or proxy in front of the server.

not_found.title: The server doesn't know this action
not_found.why: There's nothing at that API address, which usually means the app and the server are different versions.
not_found.fix: Reload the page. If it keeps happening, update the server.

not_allowed.title: The server refused this action
not_allowed.why: That API address doesn't accept this kind of request, which usually means the app and the server are different versions.
not_allowed.fix: Reload the page. If it keeps happening, update the server.

not_found.title: Session not found
not_found.why: It may have been deleted, or the link has a typo.
not_found.fix: Check the link, or pick the session from the list.

state_conflict.title: The session can't do that right now
state_conflict.why: It's {{state}}, and that action needs a different state (for example, only a live session can be paused).
state_conflict.fix: Wait for the status to update, then try again.

slug_invalid.title: That session address isn't valid
slug_invalid.why: The address (slug) goes in every link, so it can only use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, start with a letter or digit, and be at most 63 characters.
slug_invalid.fix: Use something like main-stage or room-2.

slug_taken.title: That session address is taken
slug_taken.why: Another session already uses {{slug}}, and each address has to point to one session.
slug_taken.fix: Pick another address, or edit the existing session instead.

invalid_language.title: That language isn't supported
invalid_language.why: Captions can be translated into Spanish, English, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, and the source language can only be English, Spanish or automatic.
invalid_language.fix: Pick the languages from the list.

replaced.title: Another device took over this audio input
replaced.why: A second capture page connected with the same link, and the server keeps the newest one.
replaced.fix: Close the other capture page, or reload this one to take the input back.

bad_hello.title: The capture page and the server don't agree on the audio format
bad_hello.why: The server expects 16 kHz mono 16-bit audio, and the page sent something else.
bad_hello.fix: Reload the capture page. If it keeps happening, the page is older than the server.

closed.title: The session closed the audio input
closed.why: The session stopped or was deleted, so the server stopped taking audio from this page.
closed.fix: The page reconnects on its own; start the session again to resume captions.

key_invalid.title: Google rejected the API key
key_invalid.why: The key is wrong, revoked, or can't use the Gemini API.
key_invalid.fix: Check it in Google AI Studio, then paste it again in Settings.

unavailable.title: The AI provider isn't available
unavailable.why: The session uses {{provider}}, which isn't set up on this server yet.
unavailable.fix: Pick another provider for the session, or set this one up in Settings.

error.title: The AI provider reported an error
error.why: {{provider}} failed while transcribing. Captions may have a gap.
error.fix: If it keeps happening, stop and start the session, or switch provider.

model_english_only.title: The whisper model only understands English
model_english_only.why: Local speech recognition uses {{model}}, an English-only (.en) model that can't transcribe Spanish.
model_english_only.fix: Start whisper-server with a multilingual model such as large-v3-turbo, and set its name in the local provider settings.

no_api_key.title: Gemini needs a Google API key
no_api_key.why: No Google API key is saved, so new sessions use the local provider.
no_api_key.fix: Add a key in Settings to use Gemini, or keep running everything on this computer.

key_unverified.title: The Google API key couldn’t be checked
key_unverified.why: The server couldn’t reach Google, so it doesn’t know whether the key works. New sessions use the local provider until it can check.
key_unverified.fix: Check the internet connection, then check the key again in Settings.

whisper_unreachable.title: whisper-server isn’t answering
whisper_unreachable.why: Local speech recognition needs whisper-server running at the address in the local provider settings.
whisper_unreachable.fix: Start whisper-server (see docs/dev.md) or fix its address in Settings.

ollama_unreachable.title: Ollama isn’t answering
ollama_unreachable.why: Local translation needs Ollama running at the address in the local provider settings.
ollama_unreachable.fix: Start Ollama (see docs/dev.md) or fix its address in Settings.

fallback_key_invalid.title: New sessions use the local provider
fallback_key_invalid.why: Google rejected the saved API key, so sessions set to the default provider no longer use Gemini.
fallback_key_invalid.fix: Save a valid key in Settings, or pick a provider for each session.

fallback_key_removed.title: New sessions use the local provider
fallback_key_removed.why: The Google API key was removed, so sessions set to the default provider no longer use Gemini.
fallback_key_removed.fix: Save a key in Settings to use Gemini again.

fallback_key_unverified.title: New sessions use the local provider
fallback_key_unverified.why: The Google API key couldn’t be checked because Google is unreachable, so sessions set to the default provider don’t use Gemini for now.
fallback_key_unverified.fix: Check the internet connection. The server checks the key again on its own.

restarting.title: Restarting the AI provider
restarting.why: {{provider}} stopped transcribing unexpectedly. The session stays live and tries again in {{retryInMs}} ms (attempt {{attempt}} of {{maxAttempts}}).
restarting.fix: Nothing to do yet. If it keeps failing, check that {{provider}} is reachable.

restarted.title: The AI provider is back
restarted.why: {{provider}} restarted on attempt {{attempt}}. The audio in between has no captions, and the gap is marked.

failed.title: The AI provider stopped working
failed.why: {{provider}} kept failing and didn't recover after {{attempts}} restarts, so the session stopped.
failed.fix: Check that {{provider}} is reachable (its sidecar, the network or the API key), then start the session again or switch provider.

required.title: You need to log in
required.why: This page is for the event admin, and this browser isn't logged in, or its login expired.
required.fix: Log in with the admin PIN and try again.

invalid_pin.title: Wrong PIN
invalid_pin.why: The PIN doesn't match the admin PIN set during setup.
invalid_pin.fix: Check it and try again. After a few failed tries, logging in is paused for a while.

rate_limited.title: Too many failed logins
rate_limited.why: Logging in from this device is paused after several wrong PINs, to stop guessing.

setup_required.title: Setup isn't finished
setup_required.why: No admin PIN has been set yet, so there is nothing to log in with.
setup_required.fix: Open the setup page and choose an admin PIN.

invalid_token.title: This capture link isn't valid
invalid_token.why: Its access token is wrong, or the admin generated a new one.
invalid_token.fix: Copy the capture link again from the admin page.

pin_invalid.title: Choose a different PIN
pin_invalid.why: The PIN must be {{min}} to {{max}} characters long.
pin_invalid.fix: Type a PIN of that length. Numbers are easiest to type on the event PC.

already_done.title: Setup is already done
already_done.why: An admin PIN was set before, possibly from another browser.

no_local_ca.title: There's no certificate to install
no_local_ca.why: This server doesn't use its own local certificate authority: HTTPS is off, or it uses a certificate you provided or one from Let's Encrypt, which devices already trust.
no_local_ca.fix: Nothing to install. To use the local CA, start the server without --tls-cert and without a public https address, or with --tls=local-ca.

failed.title: A caption couldn't be translated
failed.why: The translation into {{lang}} failed, so that line is missing from the {{lang}} track.
failed.fix: Check the provider's status. The next lines are translated normally.

unavailable.title: The audio source didn't start
unavailable.fix: Check the audio input and try again.

failed.title: The audio source stopped
failed.why: The {{source}} input ended with an error, so the session stopped.
failed.fix: Check the audio input, then start the session again.

unsupported.title: That audio source can't be started here
unsupported.why: Only browser capture starts from the Start button; {{source}} audio has its own controls or isn't available yet.
unsupported.fix: Use the capture page, or start the source from its own section.

file_not_found.title: Audio file not found
file_not_found.why: There's no file at that path on the server.
file_not_found.fix: Check the path. Relative paths start from the folder the server runs in.

file_not_allowed.title: That audio input isn't allowed
file_not_allowed.why: Test audio must be a file in the server's data or testdata folder, or an http(s) link.
file_not_allowed.fix: Move the file into one of those folders, or use a web link.

not_running.title: No test file is playing
not_running.why: This session isn't fed by a file right now.
not_running.fix: Nothing to stop. To stop browser capture, stop the session.

srt_unavailable.title: SRT ingest isn't available
srt_unavailable.why: The server's ffmpeg was built without libsrt, so it can't receive SRT streams.
srt_unavailable.fix: Install an ffmpeg built with libsrt (most Linux packages and the Docker image have one; Homebrew’s default ffmpeg doesn’t), or use browser capture.

srt_disabled.title: SRT ingest is turned off
srt_disabled.why: SRT is disabled in the settings.
srt_disabled.fix: Turn SRT on in Settings, or use browser capture.

srt_port_busy.title: The SRT port is in use
srt_port_busy.why: UDP port {{port}} is already taken by another program, or there are no SRT ports left.
srt_port_busy.fix: Close the program using that port, or change the first SRT port in Settings.

srt_passphrase_invalid.title: The SRT passphrase isn't valid
srt_passphrase_invalid.why: SRT passphrases must be {{min}} to {{max}} characters long.
srt_passphrase_invalid.fix: Set a new SRT passphrase in Settings, or remove it to receive without encryption.

restarting.title: Reconnecting the audio source
restarting.why: The {{source}} input failed. The session stays live and tries again in {{retryInMs}} ms (attempt {{attempt}} of {{maxAttempts}}).
restarting.fix: Nothing to do yet. If it keeps failing, check the audio input.

restarted.title: The audio source is back
restarted.why: The {{source}} input restarted on attempt {{attempt}}. The audio in between is missing, and the gap is marked.

insecure.title: This page can’t use the microphone
insecure.why: Browsers only allow audio capture on https:// addresses or on http://localhost.
insecure.fix: Open the capture link on the server computer itself (http://localhost:8080/…), or set up HTTPS for remote capture stations.

permission_denied.title: Microphone access was blocked
permission_denied.why: The browser or the operating system denied this page access to audio inputs.
permission_denied.fix: Allow the microphone in the browser’s address bar (and in the system privacy settings), then start again.

no_device.title: No audio input found
no_device.why: This computer has no microphone or line input the browser can see.
no_device.fix: Plug in the audio interface or mixer cable, then start again.

device_busy.title: The audio input is busy
device_busy.why: Another program or browser tab is using it, or the system couldn’t open it.
device_busy.fix: Close other programs that use the input, or pick another one, then start again.

device_lost.title: The audio input went away
device_lost.why: It was unplugged, or the browser stopped sharing it.
device_lost.fix: Plug it back in or pick another input, then start again.

failed.title: Audio capture couldn’t start
failed.why: The browser failed to set up audio processing.
failed.fix: Reload the page and start again. If it keeps failing, try an up-to-date Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.

not_implemented.title: This isn’t available yet
not_implemented.why: This server version doesn’t have this feature yet.
not_implemented.fix: Update Live Subtitles, or use it once the next version is out.

read_only_env.title: This key is set by an environment variable
read_only_env.why: The server reads it from its environment, so it can’t be changed or removed here.
read_only_env.fix: Change or remove the variable where the server is started, then restart it.

no_backend.title: There’s nowhere safe to store the key
no_backend.why: This computer has no system keychain, and no master key is set for the encrypted file.
no_backend.fix: Set LIVESUBS_MASTER_KEY (see docs/dev.md) and restart the server.

not_found.title: That key isn’t stored
not_found.why: It may have been removed already.
not_found.fix: Reload the page to see the current keys.

value_required.title: The key is empty
value_required.fix: Paste the key and try again.

unknown_name.title: The server doesn’t know this key
unknown_name.why: The app and the server are probably different versions.
unknown_name.fix: Reload the page. If it keeps happening, update the server.

validation_unsupported.title: This key can’t be checked
validation_unsupported.why: The server has no way to test this secret against its service.
validation_unsupported.fix: Save it and try it where it’s used.

not_found.title: Recording not found
not_found.why: It may have been deleted by an admin or by the automatic clean-up of old recordings, or the link has a typo.
not_found.fix: Pick the recording from the session's list of recordings.

invalid.title: Some settings aren't valid
invalid.why: The server didn't save anything because several fields have problems.
invalid.fix: Correct the highlighted fields, then save again.

invalid_language.title: That language isn't supported
invalid_language.why: A default language isn't in the language list, or it can't be the spoken language (only English, Spanish or automatic detection can).
invalid_language.fix: Pick the languages from the list, then save again.

invalid_url.title: That address isn't valid
invalid_url.why: It needs to be a full address with its scheme and host, such as http://127.0.0.1:8178 (or ws://127.0.0.1:4455 for OBS), without a query or credentials.
invalid_url.fix: Correct the address, then save again.

out_of_range.title: A number is out of range
out_of_range.why: One of the numbers is outside the values the server accepts.
out_of_range.fix: Use a value within the range shown under the field, then save again.

too_long.title: A value is too long
too_long.why: Model names, the interface name and the glossary are limited to 200 characters.
too_long.fix: Shorten the value, then save again.

not_found.title: We can't find that overlay preset
not_found.why: It may have been deleted, or the link has a typo.
not_found.fix: Pick a preset from the overlay presets page, or use a built-in one such as classic.

builtin_read_only.title: Built-in presets can't be changed
builtin_read_only.why: Classic box, Outline only and Lower third are part of the app, so they can't be edited or deleted.
builtin_read_only.fix: Duplicate the preset and edit the copy.

invalid.title: The preset isn't valid
invalid.why: The server didn't save it because several fields have problems.
invalid.fix: Correct the highlighted fields, then save again.

invalid_name.title: The preset needs a name
invalid_name.why: A preset name has 1 to 80 characters.
invalid_name.fix: Type a name, then save again.

invalid_color.title: That colour isn't valid
invalid_color.why: Colours are CSS colours such as #FFFFFF or rgba(0,0,0,0.5), or transparent for the background.
invalid_color.fix: Correct the colour, then save again.

out_of_range.title: A size is out of range
out_of_range.why: One of the sizes or times is outside the values the overlay accepts.
out_of_range.fix: Use a value within the range shown under the field, then save again.

not_found.title: Glossary not found
not_found.why: It may have been deleted, maybe from another admin tab.
not_found.fix: Reload the glossary list and pick it again.

invalid.title: The glossary has several problems
invalid.why: More than one field needs fixing before it can be saved.
invalid.fix: Fix the highlighted fields, then save again.

name_required.title: The glossary needs a name
name_required.why: The name is how you pick the glossary in a session.
name_required.fix: Give it a name, such as the event or the track.

term_required.title: A row has no term
term_required.why: Each row needs the term as it is spoken or written in the talk; translations alone can't be matched.
term_required.fix: Write the term, or remove the row.

term_duplicate.title: A term is listed twice
term_duplicate.why: Each term can appear only once (upper and lower case count as the same), so the models get one preferred translation.
term_duplicate.fix: Merge the two rows into one.

language_invalid.title: A translation column isn't a language code
language_invalid.why: Translation columns are named by language code, like es, en or pt-BR.
language_invalid.fix: Rename the column to a language code.

too_large.title: The glossary is too long
too_large.why: A glossary holds up to 1000 terms, entries of up to 200 characters and a name of up to 120, so it fits in the models' prompts.
too_large.fix: Shorten the long entries, or split the glossary by talk or track.

gap.title: Some audio was lost
gap.why: {{gapMs}} ms of audio at {{atSec}} s never reached the provider, because it restarted or the capture station reconnected. Those words have no captions.
gap.fix: Nothing to do if it's rare. If it happens often, check the capture station's network and the provider.

no_url.title: No caption ingestion URL
no_url.why: This session has stream captions on, but YouTube's caption ingestion URL isn't saved, so there's nowhere to send them.
no_url.fix: In YouTube Live Control Room, open Stream settings → Closed captions → "POST captions to URL", copy the URL and paste it in the session's stream captions.

url_invalid.title: That isn't a caption ingestion URL
url_invalid.why: The ingestion URL must be a full http:// or https:// address.
url_invalid.fix: Copy the whole URL from YouTube Live Control Room (it starts with http://upload.youtube.com/closedcaption) and paste it again.

unreachable.title: Can't reach YouTube to send captions
unreachable.why: The caption POST got no answer: this server may be offline or YouTube may be unreachable from its network.
unreachable.fix: Check the server's internet connection. Captions are retried automatically; lines older than about a minute are skipped.

server_error.title: YouTube is not accepting captions right now
server_error.why: YouTube answered with a temporary error (HTTP {{status}}).
server_error.fix: Nothing to do yet: captions are retried automatically. If it lasts, check the stream in YouTube Live Control Room.

rejected.title: YouTube rejected the caption
rejected.why: YouTube refused the caption (HTTP {{status}}). The ingestion URL may be old, belong to another stream, or the stream may not be live.
rejected.fix: Make sure the stream is live and "POST captions to URL" is selected, then copy the current ingestion URL again and send a test caption.

dropped.title: Some captions were skipped
dropped.why: {{count}} captions couldn't be sent in time and were too old to show on the stream.
dropped.fix: Check the connection to YouTube. New captions are sent as soon as it recovers.

obs_unreachable.title: Can't reach OBS
obs_unreachable.why: The server couldn't connect to OBS's websocket to send captions: OBS may be closed or restarting, or the websocket server may be off.
obs_unreachable.fix: Open OBS, turn on Tools → WebSocket Server Settings → Enable WebSocket server, and check the websocket URL in Settings. Captions are retried automatically.

obs_auth_failed.title: OBS rejected the password
obs_auth_failed.why: OBS's websocket server asks for a password, and the saved OBS websocket password is missing or wrong.
obs_auth_failed.fix: Copy the password from OBS (Tools → WebSocket Server Settings → Show Connect Info) and save it in Settings as the OBS websocket password.

obs_rejected.title: OBS didn't take the caption
obs_rejected.why: OBS refused the caption ({{comment}}). Captions only go out while OBS is streaming.
obs_rejected.fix: Start the stream in OBS, then send a test caption.

running.title: A benchmark is already running
running.why: Only one benchmark runs at a time, so the numbers aren't skewed.
running.fix: Wait for it to finish; its result shows up here.

runtime_unavailable.title: The local AI can't run the benchmark
runtime_unavailable.why: {{runtime}} isn't running or the server can't reach it.
runtime_unavailable.fix: Start whisper-server and Ollama, then run the benchmark again.

failed.title: The benchmark failed
failed.why: The local AI failed while transcribing or translating the test clip.
failed.fix: Check that whisper-server and Ollama are running with the chosen models, then try again.

no_speech.title: The benchmark got no text
no_speech.why: whisper-server answered but transcribed nothing from the test clip.
no_speech.fix: Check that whisper-server runs a multilingual model (for example large-v3-turbo), then try again.
